{{Quote|I am scheduled to preside over a Rodian harvest festival in three days. Rodians expect punctuality&hellip;|CGR-80|<ref name="Modest" />}}
A '''Rodian harvest festival''' was a ceremony within the culture of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Ceremony, Gala, and Ritual droid]] [[CGR-80]] was hired to preside over a harvest festival.<ref name="Modest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rodian harvest festivals were first mentioned in the conversation "A Modest Proposal" with [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]], a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Modest" />
